questions.q: Why does this lesson say an undocumented governance architecture becomes 'folklore'?
options: Because the reasons behind decisions get forgotten once the people who made them leave or move on
Because folklore is a required deliverable in enterprise architecture
Because diagrams are not allowed to be stored digitally
Because architecture only matters during the kickoff meeting
questions.explain: Without documentation, a new architect or board member can't recover why a decision was made — only the decision survives, not the reasoning.

questions.q: Which of these is part of the core documentation set this lesson describes?
options: A principles catalog that includes the rationale behind each principle
A list of every employee's personal email signature
A record of office seating assignments
A company-wide holiday calendar
questions.explain: The core set includes a principles catalog, capability map, reference diagrams, a decision log, and standards/policy pointers — not administrative records.

questions.q: What does the lesson identify as the single biggest documentation failure mode?
options: A document that was accurate the day it was written and has been wrong ever since
Having too many versions of the same document
Writing documentation in Markdown instead of a slide deck
Reviewing documentation too frequently
questions.explain: The lesson stresses that stale-but-untouched documentation, not a missing document, is the most common and dangerous failure.

questions.q: What minimum versioning practice does the lesson recommend for architecture documentation?
options: A visible last-updated date, a short change note, and one stable location people know to check
A full legal audit trail signed by outside counsel
Printing a new physical binder every week
Deleting all older versions immediately after each update
questions.explain: The lesson sets a lightweight bar: last-updated date, a brief change note, and a stable, known location — not heavy process.

questions.q: What does Lesson 25, covered next, focus on according to this lesson's roadmap?
options: A lightweight format for capturing individual architecture decisions and why they were made
How to configure a firewall
Writing SQL stored procedures
Negotiating a vendor contract
questions.explain: Lesson 25 introduces Architecture Decision Records, the format this lesson's decision log depends on.
